en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Abu Ja’far passed by a woman in Ihraam who had veiled with a vent, so heasws removed the vent himselfasws from her face’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “
Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once when passing by a woman, who in the state of Ihram had covered her face with an air vent, himself removed it from her face.’”
